transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for being here. As we all know, Nova Materials has asked our firm to represent them in a patent-infringement action against Orion Systems in federal court, covering pre-suit analysis, a complaint, and initial injunction proceedings. Nova has already supplied a draft complaint, several patent files, and a proposed engagement letter. Under our intake policy, I'm authorized to conditionally approve this representation, but that approval is contingent on having the required conflict, ethics, budget, and litigation safeguards stated in the engagement plan. Before I can make any final decision, our routine intake review requires each of the four review leads to place their finding into the meeting record through the firm's formal finding disclosure. I'll only settle on a decision after all four disclosures have been recorded. So let's begin — could each of you walk us through your area of review?
